mines.input_guard: Captured mine recovery is kind 2, Square, label 1, player-owned, with a small item handle (36/39) rather than an actor pointer. Reject this Pick up action before the prompt presser and at final Square dispatch. Also reject mine actor targets and loose-item labels 0x3B/0x64. L1 label 0x64 is Place and belongs only to the scheduled mine controller.
mines.placement_input: Type D: L1 alone until consumption or at most 1.2 seconds. Release, verify the new ground actor, allow the animation to settle, then equip a gun.
mines.confirmation: A new nearby uWp0a ground actor with +0x1CF9=1 is mandatory. Supply evidence is either actual consumption or the exact-build verified mine definition NOAMMO=1 while retaining the game-created stack. Button presses alone never count. Infinite flag prevents exhausting a five-charge stack between observations at rapid fire settings.
